subject: POC qualification & performance plan — Arkwell (next steps)
messages:
From: Marie Delacroix <marie.delacroix@arkwell.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 09:12:00 +0200
Subject: Follow-up from today's discovery — POC priorities

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the call this morning — appreciated the clear walkthrough of Redwood's runtime and the demo. I wanted to summarize Arkwell's top priorities so we can lock the POC scope quickly: 

- Business objective: Replace our current hosted transformer for intent classification with a lower-cost, lower-latency inference layer while keeping or improving prediction accuracy.
- Success signals (ideal targets): p50 latency < 150ms, p95 < 350ms; sustained throughput ~30 qps with ability to burst to 45 qps; cost/token target < $0.0008; intent accuracy (top-1) >= 92% on our validation set.
- Data / constraints: EU data residency required; small sample of 10k labeled requests available for benchmarking; some requests include long-context (2–4k tokens).
- Timeline: goal is a 4–6 week technical POC with a commercial decision shortly after. Procurement will run in parallel (expect a standard MSAs/PO).

Please send a short POC plan that includes measurable acceptance criteria, roles/owners, and a proposed timeline. Also confirm what telemetry you need from our side (payload samples, expected qps pattern, any synthetic load you require).

Best,
Marie
Marie Delacroix
Head of ML Engineering, Arkwell AI
marie.delacroix@arkwell.ai


From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marie Delacroix <marie.delacroix@arkwell.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's discovery — POC priorities

Marie — thanks for the clear list. Below is a concise POC qualification and performance plan we can execute in 4–6 weeks. Attaching our standard POC template (redwood-poc-template.xlsx) with milestones.

High-level POC plan (4 weeks baseline, optional 2-week extension):
1) Kickoff (week 0): align dataset, NDA signed, confirm EU deployment option (VPC or hosted EU region). Owners: Sales (me), Customer Success (Laura), Sales Engineer (Dev).
2) Baseline run (week 1): ingest your 10k labeled sample, run baseline model (a Redwood-verified variant) to capture latency, throughput, cost/token, and quality. Deliverable: baseline report + perf traces.
3) Optimization pass (week 2–3): apply batching, KV caching, and a quantization profile; iterate on model variant selection to meet cost/latency targets. Deliverable: optimization summary and cost projection.
4) Acceptance & handoff (week 4): run acceptance tests (see criteria below) and plan production rollout. Optional: 2-week operational soak to validate stability under sustained load.

Acceptance criteria (we propose):
- Latency: p50 < 150ms, p95 < 350ms for your sample workload.
- Throughput: sustain 20 qps steady-state on chosen footprint; burst to 45 qps for short windows.
- Cost: projected < $0.0008 / token for the optimized config (post-quantization).
- Quality: top-1 intent accuracy >= 92% on your labeled validation set, with human spot-checks (5% sampling) for semantic correctness.

Telemetry we need from you:
- A representative subset (~1k) of de-identified request/response pairs and the 10k labeled set (CSV/JSON);
- Typical QPS profile (minute-by-minute for a typical hour);
- Any long-tail payloads (>2k tokens) flagged so we can include in perf tests.

Next steps: can we schedule a 30–45 minute kickoff on the week of Jun 21? I have capacity Tue/Thu mornings (CEST). Dev, Laura — looping you in to confirm resource availability and any additional asks.

Thanks,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood-poc-template.xlsx

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Marie Delacroix <marie.delacroix@arkwell.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's discovery — POC priorities (technical clarifications)

Hi Marie — quick technical notes to make the baseline run smooth. Apologies for the detail, I want to make sure we align on inputs and measurement so the acceptance criteria are meaningful.

1) Model variants: Which family of models do you expect to test (open Llama-like, opt-family, or a customer-finetuned variant)? We can stage both a standard open checkpoint and a smaller quantized variant for cost comparison.
2) Data handling & residency: For EU residency we can run the POC in our Frankfurt region under Redwood Private (VPC). We'll need an admin contact and KMS key details if you choose private key management.
3) Load shape: please provide a 1-hour sample of minute-level QPS (CSV). If you don't have that, a synthetic profile (burst pattern + diurnal) will work.

Proposed evaluation artifacts I will deliver:
- inference-benchmark-template.csv (attached) — rows for p50/p95 latency, tokens/s, tokens per request, cost/token estimates, and quality metrics per test case.
- runbook for synthetic load generator and a small harness to replay your sample payloads with realistic inter-arrival times.

Notes on measurement:
- We'll report both end-to-end latency (downstream app + network) and server-side token latency. For fairness, please confirm if you prefer excluding network time.
- For long-context requests we will run a separate profile (2k–4k tokens) since memory/KV behavior changes performance and cost metrics.

If you can share the 1k sample and a CSV with the QPS profile, I'll stage the baseline jobs by Monday next week.

Thanks — Dev
Dev Patel
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.com

Attachment: inference-benchmark-template.csv

From: Marie Delacroix <marie.delacroix@arkwell.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, procurement@arkwell.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 11:20:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's discovery — POC priorities (confirming scope & kickoff)

Thanks Rishi and Dev — this looks good. A few confirmations from our side before the kickoff: 

- We agree with the proposed acceptance criteria (p50 <150ms / p95 <350ms, sustained 20 qps with bursts to 45 qps, cost/token target < $0.0008, intent accuracy >= 92%). Please call out which metrics will be measured server-side vs end-to-end.
- We will provide:
  * 10k labeled validation set (de-identified) + 1k quick sample for initial ingest (format: JSONL with id, prompt, gold_label).
  * QPS profile (CSV) and a short list of long-context examples.
  * A procurement contact — procurement@arkwell.ai — who will receive your MSA/contract draft after technical sign-off.
- EU residency: we prefer a VPC deployment in Frankfurt with customer KMS. Please share the onboarding checklist for Redwood Private so procurement and infra can review.

Kickoff availability: Jun 21 at 09:30 CEST works for our team. Can you send a calendar invite and include the kick deliverables?

Final ask: please confirm owners and points of contact in the kickoff invite and attach the redwood-poc-template.xlsx. Procurement will also expect a short SOW (1 page) and a preliminary cost estimate for the test run.

I'll upload the 1k sample and QPS CSV to the Drive link you shared and will send the sample payloads (arkwell_sample_payloads.json) via secure transfer by end of day tomorrow.

Best,
Marie
Marie Delacroix
Head of ML Engineering, Arkwell AI
marie.delacroix@arkwell.ai

Attachments referenced: arkwell_sample_payloads.json
